title: Transcript panel scans the whole word index once per paragraph per line on every redraw while a cut is shown (70-255 ms per keystroke / edit)
where: editor tree: features/transcripts/client.ts:2702-2711 (#blockHtml spans()), via #syncBody 2662 from #renderFind 1057 and #render/#renderDoc
what: With a cut shown, spans(field) walks all of d.words for each paragraph and each line, so one #syncBody is blocks x 2 x words, before the per-paragraph diff of PERF.md rule 15.
cost: 267 paragraphs / 48k rows: 69.7 ms per #syncBody; 600 / 72k (3-hour interview): 255 ms; paid on every find keystroke, every edit while open, every pick. PERF.md rule 15's 'no long task above 60 ms' does not hold with a cut shown.
evidence: probe_spans.mjs on the verbatim loop: 69.7 ms and 255.2 ms; grouped by ref|field: 2.6 / 3.9 ms.
fix: Index d.words by ref|field once per document (WeakMap) and walk only the paragraph's rows; output identical.

title: englishOfSpan / bestEnglishOfCut re-squeeze every paragraph of the clip on every call (5-7 ms per lookup at 600 paragraphs, on the edit frame)
where: editor tree: features/align/shared.ts:728-748 (wordsInCut), 684-703 (bestEnglishOfCut), 1097, 1123, 1172; callers features/translate/local.ts:56, features/translate/server.ts:127/397
what: Each paragraph's original is folded to letters and searched for every call; the existing squeezedOf WeakMap memo is not used by wordsInCut and there is no containment prefilter.
cost: 300-600 stored paragraphs: 4.3-7.0 ms per englishOfSpan, 4.6-6.4 ms per overrunOf; each trim/split mints a new key so the edit frame pays it (10 ms budget); hundreds of cuts at load = 1.5-2 s main thread (estimated).
evidence: probe_align.mjs P=600: englishOfSpan 4.75 ms, bestEnglishOfCut 4.98 ms, wordsInCut x P 4.85 ms; memoised-letters prefilter 0.02 ms.
fix: Memoise squeezed letters + positions per alignment (extend squeezedOf) and prefilter paragraphs by includes(needle) before englishOfCutDetail; same answers and tie-break.

title: projectCut costs 25-47 ms per call on the server event loop (quadratic edge search, nothing memoised), one caller re-runs it per request
where: editor tree: features/align/shared.ts:809-935 (839-854 edge search, 868 re-squeeze); callers features/align/server.ts:216-229 (miss retried every 20 s), features/aids/server.ts:416-424 (no memo)
what: For each non-containing paragraph the head/tail overlap search rebuilds two joined strings per candidate length from max down to 4, after joining both arrays for idx(); paragraphs are re-squeezed per call; all synchronous on the editor server.
cost: 300 x 160 letters: 24.6 ms per call; 600 x 80: 44-47 ms per call; misses re-projected every 20 s per unit and derivedWords per word-links request: tens to hundreds of ms of blocked event loop per batch (estimated) while sync clients wait.
fix: Memoise per-alignment squeezed letters, find candidates by includes on joined letters, compute edge overlap in one pass; memoise derivedWords like derived. Keep the 0.9 coverage rule and longest-hit-first selection.

title: The words service folds the clip's whole token stream again for every changed cut (foldShift), synchronously
where: editor tree: features/transcripts/shared.ts:587-614 (foldShift), via wordsFix 566 in the synchronous loop of features/transcripts/derive.ts:52 (fixesFor), used by span edits and sweep (209-221)
what: The folded letter stream and token boundaries depend only on the (cached) tokens array but are rebuilt per changed cut, with no await between cuts of a clip.
cost: 4.0 ms per changed cut at 30k tokens, 7.0 ms at 50k; a sweep, whisper re-cut or multi-cut undo of ~700 cuts blocks the editor server 3.5-5 s.
fix: Memoise {f, starts, boundary} per tokens array in a WeakMap (as sortedCache does), find p by bisect; optionally yield every N cuts in fixesFor. Results identical.

title: The shelf replaces every staged card's DOM when any one changes
where: editor tree: features/shelf/client.ts:585-619 (#renderHost signature includes the project, then setHtml = innerHTML of the whole list)
what: Playhead ticks are skipped, but any project change rebuilds the full shelf string and, if one card's markup differs, re-creates every card node, against PERF.md rule 5 (patch, don't replace).
cost: 667 staged cards (PERF.md reference list): every staged-card edit, colour, gain, words-service setText or bench card change re-creates ~667 subtrees; estimated 10-30 ms per change, not measured.
evidence: Code read; client/views/ui.ts:163 setHtml is string compare then innerHTML.
fix: Use morphInto/patchHtml or a per-row markup diff keyed by cut id (the transcript panel's #bodyList pattern); keep content-visibility.
